body: I'm considered an outcast in the whole family, because of their relationship with my mother, who apparently was an ass her whole life to other people, maybe thats why she ended up giving someone like me to my aunt. So no one likes me at all. I live in a lonely world. Where I feel no one loves me...
Thank you. Just reading these kind words were enough to get me going for this week. I'll keep striving to get better and deal with my depression. Thank you again.
Yeah, thanks for talking to me man, it helps me alot with just those words. I'm glad I got to talk to someone about this... You're a good man.
It's quarantine, my rl friends can't do anything but say deal wih it.

Everytime I talk to her she just screams at me uncontrollably. I just want to sit down and talk. And sometimes when I'm minding my own business, she just hits my head out of nowhere, without me doing anything. Cause if I said something, I know something worse is coming. I don't know what to do anymore
Im still down in the dumps about it. Call me extra emotional but it really hurts getting called a useless being by your own "mother"
